انصهرت (form VII)
# اِنْصَهَرْتُ (inṣahartu) /in.sˤa.har.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# اِنْصَهَرْتَ (inṣaharta) /in.sˤa.har.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# اِنْصَهَرْتِ (inṣaharti) /in.sˤa.har.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْصَهَرَ (inṣahara)
# اِنْصَهَرَتْ (inṣaharat) /in.sˤa.ha.rat/: third-pe
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
